slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Lambda for low-traffic agents
slides.subtitle: Small agent tools do not always need an always-on server.

slides.title: The previous setup
slides.body: The first deployment used a containerized web app. It worked, but the service still had to run somewhere.

slides.title: Lambda changes the cost model
slides.body: The function wakes up on invocation. If nobody uses the tool, there is no always-on server to pay for.

slides.title: Still a full app
slides.body: The Lambda Function URL served the frontend, handled the agent API, and streamed responses back to the browser.

slides.title: Use it for the right workload
slides.body: Lambda fits personal agents, internal tools, and occasional workflows. A steady public product may be simpler as a normal web service.
